subject: Marketplace compliance pack for partner enablement - SOC2, pen-test letter, DPA
messages:
From: marketplace-ops@amazon.com (Maya Chen)
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace listing - security artifacts needed for co-sell enablement

Hi Karthik,

We're moving CloudMall's listing into the co-sell review queue and need the standard security/compliance artifacts to complete marketplace verification and partner enablement. Please provide the following:

- SOC 2 Type II attestation (most recent)
- Penetration test letter / executive summary (signed by vendor)
- Fully executed DPA or draft that we can accept
- Completed vendor security questionnaire (if you have one)
- Encryption and data residency details, and whether logs/audit are retained (retention period)

Can you upload these to the secure Drive link below or share via DocuSign for signed items? Ideally we need everything by EOD Thu 2026-03-12 to keep the co-sell timeline.

Secure upload: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/submit-to-marketplace

Thanks,
Maya Chen
AWS Marketplace Ops
marketplace-ops@amazon.com

--
Note: For questions about co-sell handoffs, you can reach the partner onboarding queue at marketplace-onboarding@amazon.com

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com (Karthik Iyer)
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: marketplace-ops@amazon.com
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing - security artifacts needed for co-sell enablement

Thanks Maya — looping in the compliance and legal owners so we can assemble this quickly.

Stephanie / Security: can you pull the SOC2 Type II PDF (2025 report) and the pen-test vendor summary? If the full pen test report is restricted, include the signed letter and the executive summary.

Lauren / Legal: please prepare the most recent DPA and set up a DocuSign envelope for signature; if you prefer to share a draft first, flag required redlines.

Priya / Partner Ops: please coordinate upload to the Drive folder linked below once we have the files, and confirm access for Maya. Also update HubSpot deal HUBSPOT-20091 with "Marketplace submission - security artifacts uploaded".

Target timeline: artifacts uploaded by Thu 2026-03-12 EOD PST. If there are any blockers (redlines on DPA, pen-test NDAs) call them out now.

Thanks all — I will send the final package to Maya once we have everything.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

> Thanks Maya — looping in the compliance and legal owners so we can assemble this quickly.

Quick update — attaching the artifacts we control and publishing to the shared folder:

- SOC2_Attestation_2025.pdf (Type II attestation, audit period: 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31) [attachment stub]
- PenTest_Summary_2025.pdf (executive summary and signed letter from third-party vendor; full report is classified per vendor agreement) [attachment stub]

Notes on the pen test: the vendor has redacted certain internal IP details; the letter contains scope, severity breakdown, and confirmation that critical findings were remediated. If AWS or CloudMall needs the unredacted doc they will need an NDA with the testing firm — let me know and we'll coordinate.

I've uploaded the two PDFs here for AWS: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d5e6f (permissions: read-only for external link; can add Maya if needed).

I will hand off DPA work to Lauren — I have one minor datapoint to confirm (log retention: 180 days by default; longer retention offered as enterprise add-on).

Attachments: SOC2_Attestation_2025.pdf (pdf, 3.9MB), PenTest_Summary_2025.pdf (pdf, 1.4MB)

Stephanie Nguyen
Security & Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

DocuSign envelope (DPA for signature): https://www.docusign.net/envelope/ABC123XYZ

Karthik / Amanda —

Confirmed receipt of the Drive folder and the DocuSign envelope. Package looks complete for initial verification — SOC2 attestation and pen-test summary meet our checklist.

One small item: legal flagged an appendix in the DPA related to liability caps that we typically standardize for marketplace listings. We can accept a redline to Appendix B (liability language) or we can propose a marketplace-standard clause; either way please coordinate with Lauren and push an updated DocuSign envelope. Once we have the final DPA we will proceed to internal review and expect the co-sell enablement approval within 5–7 business days, barring further issues.

Next steps for you:
- Push DPA redline (if any) by end of Tue 2026-03-16
- Confirm access for Amanda (CloudMall) to the Drive folder (we added Maya's account)

I'll follow up in the marketplace queue once legal signs off. Thanks for moving quickly on this.

Best,
Maya Chen
AWS Marketplace Ops
marketplace-ops@amazon.com
